blocks.text: The dative for the person whose age it is
The person whose age is in question is in the dative case.
«Expressions referring to age are rendered in Russian as follows: **Сколько вам лет?** **Мне двадцать лет**. The person whose age is in question is in the dative case.»

DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 41. One sentence at a time, in a new order each time you open this chapter; it is finished when every one has been answered right. The sentences are real: the source of each is shown with it.

exercises.why: **семьдесят три года** — 2–4, 22–24, 32–34… (not 12–14) take the genitive singular (год → года); 1, 21, 31… take the nominative singular.
